facts: About 1.7 million people within the city limits
On the Ishim river, in the north of the country
worth_knowing: Founded as Aqmoly in 1830, then Akmolinsk, Tselinograd and Aqmola. It became Astana, 'capital' in Kazakh, in 1998. As Nur-Sultan from 2019, it reverted to Astana in 2022.
